title: Scaling Laws of SignSGD in Linear Regression: When Does It Outperform SGD?
abstract: arXiv:2603.02069v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study scaling laws of signSGD under a power-law random features (PLRF) model that accounts for both feature and target decay. We analyze the population risk of a linear model trained with one-pass signSGD on Gaussian-sketched features. We express the risk as a function of model size, training steps, learning rate, and the feature and target decay parameters. Comparing against the SGD risk analyzed by Paquette et al. (2024), we identify a drift-normalization effect and a noise-reshaping effect unique to signSGD. We then obtain compute-optimal scaling laws under the optimal choice of learning rate. Our analysis shows that the noise-reshaping effect can make the compute-optimal slope of signSGD steeper than that of SGD in regimes where noise is dominant. translated_title: 线性回归中SignSGD的缩放定律：它何时优于SGD？
translated_abstract: 我们研究了signSGD在幂律随机特征（PLRF）模型下的缩放定律，该模型同时考虑了特征衰减和目标衰减。我们分析了在高斯草绘特征上使用单遍signSGD训练的线性模型的总体风险，并将风险表示为模型大小、训练步数、学习率以及特征和目标衰减参数的函数。通过与Paquette等人（2024）分析的SGD风险进行比较，我们识别出signSGD特有的漂移归一化效应和噪声重塑效应。随后，我们在学习率的最优选择下获得了计算最优的缩放定律。我们的分析表明，在噪声占主导的区域，噪声重塑效应可以使signSGD的计算最优斜率比SGD更陡峭。最后，我们观察到广泛使用的预热-稳定-衰减（WSD）调度在特征衰减较快但目标衰减较慢的情况下，能进一步降低噪声项并使计算最优斜率更加陡峭。
tldr: 该论文首次在幂律随机特征模型下推导出signSGD的计算最优缩放定律，揭示了其特有的噪声重塑效应使signSGD在噪声主导的区域中计算最优斜率比SGD更陡峭，从而阐明了signSGD何时能优于SGD。
en_tdlr: This paper derives compute-optimal scaling laws for signSGD under a power-law random features model, showing that its unique noise-reshaping effect yields a steeper compute-optimal slope than SGD in noise-dominated regimes, thereby explaining when signSGD outperforms SGD.
